generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
The Tenderer shall quote rates exclusive of GST. RPCL reserves the right to seek additional information as it deems fit to satisfy itself of the Bidders eligibility.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The intending bidder should have executed at least one similar work of value not less than Rs. 36,45,618/- (Rupees Thirty Six Lakh Fourty Five Thousand Six Hundred and Eighteen Only) in Dismantling/Supply/Erection/Testing & Commissioning of LT/HT Switchgear/MCC panels of 415V class and above in any PSU/Reputed industries, during any one year in the preceding five financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26). Proof shall be a Purchase/Work Order copy along with a work done/performance certificate issued by the General Manager/Chief Engineer/Head of the client organization or by the competent authority.

The intending bidder shall be an OEM/authorized dealer/system integrator of LT/HT Switchgear/Motor Control Centre (MCC) panels (415V class and above, up to 3200A and above, IS 8623/IEC 61439 compliant) and Valid Class II and above electrical contractor licence issued from the GOK.
